---
title: "PCA"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
options(bitmapType = "cairo")
dat_avg <- readRDS("../data/data_aug.rds")
```

## Wrangling

### Make wide

```{r}
dat_avg_wide <- dat_avg |>   
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(title,geo_accession, mouse, timepoint, tissue),
              names_from  = ENTREZ_ID,
              values_from = expression
              )
```

### Make experimental matrix

```{r}
expr_mat <- dat_avg_wide |>
  dplyr::select(-title, -geo_accession, -mouse, -timepoint, -tissue) |>
  as.matrix()

rownames(expr_mat) <- dat_avg_wide$title
tissues <- unique(dat_avg_wide$tissue)
```

## Quality check **EVALUATE THE DISTANCE CORRELATION**

```{r}
# Sample-vs-sample distance = 1 - Pearson correlation (the paper's setting).
sample_dist <- as.dist(1 - cor(t(expr_mat)))                   
hc <- hclust(sample_dist, method = "complete")                 
 
# Colour code: one colour per organ (named vector so we can look colours up by organ)
tissue_cols <- set_names(rainbow(length(tissues)), tissues)    # rainbow(5) gives 5 colours; set_names() labels each with its organ

plot(hc, labels = FALSE, hang = -1,                            
     main = "Sample clustering")  
points(seq_along(hc$order), rep(0, length(hc$order)),          
       col = tissue_cols[dat_avg_wide$tissue[hc$order]], pch = 15)    
legend("topright", legend = names(tissue_cols), col = tissue_cols, pch = 15) 
```

## PCA for all organs

```{r}
pca <- prcomp(expr_mat, scale. = TRUE)

pca.var <- pca$sdev^2
pca.var.per <- as_tibble(round(pca.var/sum(pca.var)*100, 1)) |>
  rowid_to_column("PC") 


ggplot(data = head(pca.var.per, 15), aes(PC,value)) +
  geom_col() +
  xlab("Principal Component") + 
  ylab("Percent variation") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Scree Plot")


```

#### Make ggplot PCA 1 and 2

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
pca.data <- data.frame(Sample=rownames(pca$x),
                       X=pca$x[,1],
                       Y=pca$x[,2],
                       tissue = dat_avg_wide$tissue,
                       time = dat_avg_wide$timepoint)
ggplot(data=pca.data, 
       aes(X, Y, label=Sample, color=tissue, shape=time)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab(paste("PC1 - ", pca.var.per[1,2], "%", sep="")) + 
  ylab(paste("PC2 - ", pca.var.per[2,2], "%", sep="")) +
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("My PCA graph")
```

#### Make ggplot PCA 1 and 3


### Check loading scores for PC1of all organs

```{r}
loading_scores <- pca$rotation[,1]
gene_scores <- abs(loading_scores)
gene_scores_ranked <- sort(gene_scores, decreasing = TRUE)
top_10_genes <- names(gene_scores_ranked[1:10])
top_10_genes
pca$rotation[top_10_genes,1]
```
